items.summary: ゲーム音楽が流れる中庭，ゲーム機や原画が並ぶ教室，初対面の人と楽しむ謎解き。「TheTenthMosaic」には，ゲームとアートを日常の延長で楽しめる空間が広がっていた。展示や企画を巡りながら過ごした2日間を振り返る。

zh.title: 一个略带神秘又舒适的空间，游戏与艺术融入日常生活。在“第十马赛克”度过的两天报告【第十马赛克】
zh.summary: 播放游戏音乐的庭院，摆满游戏机和原创图画的教室，与你从未见过的人一起解开谜团。 “TheTenthMosaic”拥有宽敞的空间，您可以在这里享受游戏和艺术，作为日常生活的延伸。回顾这两天的展览和项目参观。

en.title: A slightly mysterious and comfortable space where games and art blend into everyday life. Report on the two days spent at “The Tenth Mosaic” [The Tenth Mosaic]
en.summary: A courtyard with game music playing, a classroom lined with game consoles and original drawings, and solving mysteries with people you've never met before. ``TheTenthMosaic'' has a spacious space where you can enjoy games and art as an extension of your daily life. Looking back on the two days spent touring the exhibitions and projects.

items.title: 第10の芸術・ゲームを辿る。ゲームの歴史と多様な表現を巡るイベントで見えてきた，インディペンデントな創作精神の系譜［The Tenth Mosaic］
items.summary: 往年のゲーム機にゲームのアート，インディーゲーム。カルチャーイベント「TheTenthMosaic」には，時代やジャンルの垣根を越え，多彩なゲームと表現が集まった。イベントに参加して見えてきた，作り手たちの精神とそのつながりを考える。

zh.title: 遵循第十艺术/游戏。通过围绕游戏历史的事件和多样化表达揭示的独立创作精神的谱系【第十马赛克】
zh.summary: 旧游戏机上的游戏艺术和独立游戏。文化活动“TheTenthMosaic”汇集了超越时代和流派界限的各种游戏和表现形式。通过参与活动，思考创作者的精神以及他们之间的联系。

en.title: Follow the 10th art/game. The genealogy of the independent creative spirit revealed through events surrounding the history of games and diverse expression [The Tenth Mosaic]
en.summary: Game art and indie games on old game consoles. The cultural event ``TheTenthMosaic'' brought together a wide variety of games and expressions that transcended the boundaries of era and genre. Think about the spirit of the creators and the connections between them, as seen by participating in the event.

items.title: 「Rez」制作現場で起きていた，90年代のゲームとテクノの邂逅。水口哲也氏が語った“プレイヤーが音楽を生み出すゲーム”への挑戦［The Tenth Mosaic］
items.summary: 「TheTenthMosaic」で行われた「Rez」25周年記念トークセッションは，ゲーム史のみならず，90年代のテクノ・エレクトロ史を振り返る貴重な機会となった。シナスタジアへの挑戦とテクノアーティストたちとの交流。水口哲也氏やケン・イシイ氏らが語った，ゲームと音楽が交わった制作の舞台裏をお届けする。

zh.title: 90年代游戏与techno的邂逅，发生在《Rez》的制作现场。水口哲也谈“玩家创作音乐的游戏”的挑战【第十张马赛克】
zh.summary: 在“TheTenthMosaic”举办的“Rez”25 周年纪念讲座是一个宝贵的机会，不仅可以回顾游戏的历史，还可以回顾 20 世纪 90 年代的 techno 和 electro 的历史。接受联觉的挑战并与科技艺术家互动。我们为您带来水口哲也、石井健等人讲述的游戏与音乐交叉的幕后制作。

en.title: The encounter between 90's games and techno that took place at the production site of "Rez". Tetsuya Mizuguchi talks about the challenge of “a game where players create music” [The Tenth Mosaic]
en.summary: The ``Rez'' 25th anniversary talk session held at ``TheTenthMosaic'' was a valuable opportunity to look back not only at the history of games, but also the history of techno and electro in the 1990s. Taking on the challenge of Synesthesia and interacting with techno artists. We bring you a behind-the-scenes look at the production where games and music intersect, as told by Tetsuya Mizuguchi, Ken Ishii, and others.

en.title: ``The Midnight Barber'' is a narrative ADV that uses rhythm to uncover information about incidents hidden behind the city. The customers who come to the barber shop late at night are fairies and werewolves.

items.summary: SAGABarcelonaGameFest2026にて，カタルーニャを拠点とするCocodroloGamesが手掛ける，学校を舞台にしたソーシャルシミュレーター「SkoolDays」をチェックしてきた。一見するとポップでかわいらしいシミュレーションゲームだが，10代の複雑な人間関係や，正解のない選択の難しさをリアルに体験できる作品となっている。

zh.title: 体验不分黑白的人际关系和选择的重量！看看来自加泰罗尼亚的学校生活模拟游戏“Skool Days”[游玩报告]

en.title: Experience the weight of human relationships and choices that cannot be divided into black and white! Check out the school life sim “Skool Days” from Catalonia [Play Report]
en.summary: At SAGABarcelonaGameFest2026, I checked out ``SkoolDays'', a social simulator set in a school, created by Catalonia-based CocodroloGames. At first glance, it looks like a pop and cute simulation game, but it is a work that allows you to realistically experience the complex human relationships of teenagers and the difficulty of making choices with no correct answer.

en.summary: The complete version of "Total War: Shogun 2" released earlier this week caused negative reviews from players due to various problems including the use of "inferior AI". It is reported that existing game holders will not be affected during the official investigation and can still access and play normally. (The game has been labeled "artificial intelligence," "psychological horror," "capitalism" and "black comedy.") Sega and Creative Assembly said the full version of the experience failed to meet player expectations and failed to meet its own quality standards. en.title: Weird stories: Opening a pawn shop in the cyber world
en.summary: He is very fond of weird things, and talks about nonsense, ghost things, and new things related to games every day. Picture / Ronaldinho Since the end of September, I have often seen discussions about a simulation business game on social media. Many players said that although there is only a demo at the moment, they have been addicted to it for more than ten hours or even hundreds of hours. "Is it really that fun?" With such doubts and curiosity, I opened "Probably Stolen" on the night of the last day of the National Day holiday. In the store details, the game is introduced as a "cyberpunk store management simulation game set in a dystopian space station." The combination of these three labels has a wonderful effect. The first two constitute more of the background and atmosphere of the game, as well as the specific expression of the "simulation management" gameplay. To put it bluntly, in a bad social background setting, the "profiteers" played by the players need to trade some unusual things.

ja.summary: 変なものが大好きで、くだらない話や幽霊の話、ゲーム関連の新ネタなどを日々語っています。こんにちは、このクラスメートと先生です！ （写真／ロナウジーニョ） 6か月のキャリア空白期間を経て、私の「プロフェッショナルとしてのアイデンティティ」は地球を揺るがす変化を遂げた。 「社会に出るとアイデンティティは自分で決まる」と言われますが、多くの場合、私たちの「職業上のアイデンティティ」は業界文化や慣性によって規定されるので、私は「クラスメート」から「先生」になりました。元ゲームデザイナーとして「同級生」になるのは自然なことだった。ゲーム業界の実務家の多くはインターンシップからスタートし、学生として「インターンシップの同級生」になります。しかし、私が学校を卒業して正式に働き始めた後、クラスメイトは私と一緒に卒業しませんでした。その結果、私は「企画のクラスメイト」、もう少し噛み砕いて言うと「コピーライティングのクラスメイト」になりました。他の「企画系の学生」「美術系の学生」「プログラミング系の学生」と交流するのが日々の仕事です。

en.title: Machi★Asobi vol.31 “Super Kaguya Hime! Talk Show” report, 8 months after its release on Netflix, “Super Kaguya Hime! What has happened so far and what will happen in the future?
en.summary: On Saturday, October 17, 2026, when Machi★Asobi vol.31 was held, the entire city of Tokushima became an event venue full of anime, games, and manga, the ``Super Kaguya Hime! Talk Show'' was held. The anime movie ``Super Kaguya Hime!'', which started as an exclusive distribution on Netflix, was so popular that its one-week screening at movie theaters was extended to four months, and was eventually revived in special formats such as 4DX, achieving box office revenue of 3 billion yen. I was granted permission to interview a talk event featuring Anna Nagase, who played the main character, Iroha Sakayori, and Kazuma Momohara of Studio Colorido, who served as the animation producer of the film, so I would like to take a look at what they talked about for a full hour.

en.title: Whether you take risks may change depending on your posture when sitting in a chair
en.summary: Your mood changes when you're cocooned in a small space and when you're stretching out in an open space. A 2026 study found that subtly guiding subjects' posture by changing the height of a table led to changes in their willingness to take "risks." read more...
